seo.title: A 3,400-Year-Old Royal Tragedy Revealed in Clay
seo.description:
Archaeologists uncovered 131 cuneiform tablets revealing a deadly epidemic and a nursing princess during King Tudhaliya II's reign. These ancient texts preserved a hidden royal tragedy for 3,400 years.

#AncientHistory #Archaeology #History #Cuneiform

Sources:
